findings.detail: A monitor scan fails after the final foreground check while close waits for it. close returns successfully despite owner._error being set, so worker can exit0 and guardian can mark finished.
findings.required_fix: After stopping and joining the monitor, propagate any stored monitor error before permitting successful close. Preserve lease cleanup using finally. Add a deterministic late-failure test and a clean-close test.

monitor_failure: GuardFailure('Synthetic resource failure after final foreground check')
